title: VTA Calendar — Busy — Share — payload
description: A client turns on or off, for one trust context, sharing the principal's busy times with one booking page — merged, coarsened intervals and nothing else. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

enabled.description: True shares busy times with the target from now on; false stops at once (VTI-CAL-060).

Response.title: VTA Calendar — Busy — Share — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/calendar/busy/share/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/calendar/busy/share/0.1#response.
